subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Uses capital letters, full stops, commas, question marks, exclamation marks and inverted commas correctly

show.line: I bought apples, pears and bananas. Commas keep the things in a list apart. Breathe at each comma!

rounds.prompt: Which sentence uses commas in the list correctly?
Which mark goes between things in a list?
I have a dog, a cat, a fish and a bird. Count the commas.
rounds.praise: Three commas! And joins the last two.

rounds.prompt: Read this out loud. Pause at each comma.
rounds.text: We need bread, milk, eggs and sugar.
accept: we need bread milk eggs and sugar

rounds.prompt: Red, yellow, green and ... Say one more colour for the list.
Where is the comma missing? Tap the gap.
A list, or not a list? Sort the sentences.

hints: A comma goes between the things in a list.
Before the last thing, use and instead of a comma.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write my shopping list in a sentence.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I need bread milk eggs and jam. No commas needed!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The list needs commas. Bread, milk, eggs and jam.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's add them together. Bread, comma, milk, comma, eggs and jam!

parent_line: Can use commas to separate things in a list.
